title: neogundam
description: Random item for early game and end game, with some item without recipes, for modpack's creatore and kubejs/craftweaker and a full set of a coloured blocks and painting.
body:
neoGundam
A little help in early game, a big help in end game!

+++important note: I'm currently working on making the mod less heavy, if anyone has any suggestions, please contact me+++

Featured:
> A dust producted with a piece of bedrock in a furnace.
- This dust is a way to access my modpack endgame.

![Gundamite recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3f816bda467ecdd6d5d154befd67b07dd7e70ff5.png)    

![Bedrock recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21a2ec62744cad6cecef9f233ae22a9d383d2ee2.png)

> An incredible, strong sword (press k to launch thunders).

![Juki's Sword recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/71bf16e56e57289c521b65b9977d9524b307a3a7.png)    

> A mining helmet that provide slow falling when equipped. 

![Mining Helmet Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a235868308e44934da0f3c8dc7b2c3e488c172b.png)

> A "sleeper" for multiplayer. When is night, sleeper just set time in day.

![Sleeper recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3cb789d39cd35e7f3957ae2d50b339e2fa60e77.png)

> A "hot" torch. This torch, even if you don't have torch in your inventory, when is in secondary hand, provide to place a torch when the light block is equal to zero. So, just mine without thinking about placing torches!

![Hot Torch recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/625d26ba7eeee62549fcaf2dfcd44ab4b71afc6e.png)

> A fully coloured set of brick blocks, stairs, wall, slabs, fences, fence gates, trapdoors and doors!!! (orange is an example, the recipes is the same for other colours)

![Coloured Stone Bricks recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93af2022b44c899705d6d7af01292edae98d143a.png)    ![Coloured Stone Brick Stairs recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80b5b1274624fd83baec249802b7334961edf29e.png)    ![Coloured Stone Brick Slabs recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/257eb4915beca6053313423cad457b91022483c4.png)    ![Coloured Stone Brick Walls recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d3728b456310d0e326f05a6ccb4fbb6779457e55.png)    ![Coloured Fences recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6cb9e69c95649f339b02fd1da9a0cf88cd2dbfde.png)    ![Coloured Fence Gates recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef6bf4d5930b0e8fda163a3c52b7079076123376.png)      
![Coloured Trapdoors recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dbb8a97380c107cd71a9e1c2fee5c0c97eed9c9c.png)   
![Coloured Doors recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/17de022572e63f333be00a2c2c2aa0518a98cc3a.png)

> A Wither Resistance potion!

![Whiter Resistance Potion recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f4ee44dc3774b4175b8454cec0c0aa80f733d1ef.png)    ![Whiter Resistance Effect.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a191b2664536ec80bd7e320cbb4d33410426e4d2.png)                 
> A "redstone lamp" fence that glow up when is night!

![Redstone Fence recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7f92a388c2d9165daa03f97b426d4ebce9e2a52.png)

> A butch of new painting made with IA

![An example.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e7b8d665574a020c6d61baf74bdbbfd562e80fd.png)

> Last, but not less important... The Andromeda Armor... Yes... You have to beat Warden at least two time, it will have been worth it!

![Andromeda Helmet recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1767b71ad2dbc5ef93d0b9d41a3a732855b5210.png)
![Andromeda Chestplate recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f2d1a473e768f9269c37e646a318c466b9d7777.png)    ![Andromeda Leggings recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/618b77752ca91c02d231aff846c004682d6054c6.png)    

![Andromeda Boots recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b956bc67e85d341daeae89d092bc522a6303b3da.png)              

I hope you enjoy my first mod, that will be continuously updated!

Gundam
